A '''facility''' was built by the ancient [[Tythan|Tythonian]] [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] civilization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The [[Je'daii Order]] established a stone structure that would come to be known as [[Kaleth]]&mdash;a Je'daii word meaning "sanctum"&mdash;below the massive [[Tho Yor]], encasing within it the ancient ruins of the facility.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
